contract.intent: Validate the modular SDLC engine with explicit capability boundaries, deterministic phase execution, provenance-bound artifacts, replaceable real-execution adapters, and read-only loop observability with measured assurance.

outcomes.statement: The package typechecks, tests, builds, and packs as @agentskit/harness at the version in package.json.
The real CLI is runnable and exposes both ak-harness and ak-verify.
Repository governance and release documentation are complete and internally consistent.
Issue/worktree claims and dispatch records are atomic, idempotent, and human-recoverable.
Retryable quota/timeout failures use bounded recovery while policy and validation failures fail closed.
Changed-file preflight selects narrow checks and rejects shell-composed dispatch commands.
Adversarial review, PR content approval, publication gates, and QA transition decisions are deterministic and hash-bound.
Phase telemetry and quality matrices report bounded 0-100 scores, honest unknowns, baseline deltas, and classified watchdog blockers.

A versioned eval battery covers all execution layers and supported components, repeats deterministically, reports min/median/max, and blocks unknown, stale, critical, subjective, or unapproved regression evidence.
AgentsKit ecosystem compatibility is represented by pinned revisions, real-adapter commands, baseline bindings, and fail-closed evidence assessment.
A new consumer can run the documented minimum profile and adapter example without importing internal modules, with troubleshooting and organization guidance available.
The release candidate has a versioned manifest, current package metadata, and a main-only Trusted Publishing path with explicit unresolved blockers.
Portable block, status, retro/learning, model-policy, and machine-policy records validate deterministically.
Coding-agent, Orca, Doc Bridge, memory, cache, runtime, and tracking adapters expose provider-neutral contracts with explicit assurance, telemetry, bounded failures, and idempotent dry-run behavior.
Capability modules are organized under explicit boundaries and forbidden kernel/provider imports fail deterministically.
Phase profiles declare inputs, outputs, dependencies, gates, bounded retries, budgets, effects, and deterministic pass/block/escalate/retry/cancel/resume routing.
Versioned artifacts bind run provenance, render as JSON and Markdown, record decisions in the event log, reject stale bindings, and resume completed phases without replaying handlers.
The loop exposes a deterministic, read-only observability report with actionable anomaly detection and operating metrics.

The local UI exposes a protected, live operational projection of loop tasks and events, reconciles it against the tracker and Orca, locks destructive actions on stale or out-of-sync data, and executes only kernel functions.

ui.reason: The local operational UI is covered by the ui criterion; browser-backed screenshot evidence remains outside this CLI contract.
